spans.s: दुःख (I) a. (f. खा) 1. Painful, unpleasant, e.g. ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्; 2. uneasy, difficult.
दुःख (II) n. 1. Unhappiness, sorrow, distress, pain, agony, तनयाविश्लेषदुःखैर्नवैः Sak.iv., K.S.iv.4; 2. difficulty, trouble, क्लेशितः कर्मदुःखैः Sr.
.(The acc. and inst. singulars of this word, viz., दुःखम् and दुःखेन are used as indeclinables in the sense of ‘with great trouble, with great difficulty,’ Bg.xii.5.)
